_about: Characters, designs and casting, kept apart from the screenplays so a recast never touches a script.
Speaker IDs in the outlines, Fountain scripts and audio manifests are the keys below.
Chosen voices approved Nov 27, 2026 (the first candidate for each kitten); the other candidates stay listed in case an audition changes a choice.

reserved_voices.af_heart: Haynes narrator, reserved for the Haynes film. Never use for a kitten, even in a blend.

pascal.name: Pascal
pascal.personality: Energetic, competitive card player and enthusiastic experimental mathematician. Makes bold conjectures; his intuition sometimes leads him astray.

voice.future: Possible Brooklyn accent with a human actor or another engine, with consent and licenses respected

sophie.name: Sophie
sophie.personality: Curious; thinks in pictures. Introduces finite geometry, Steiner systems and Curtis's kitten.

ada.name: Ada
ada.personality: Precise and skeptical, with a dry sense of humor. Enjoys algorithms, coding theory, the MINIMOG and checking claims.

euler.name: Euler
euler.personality: Thoughtful and somewhat absent-minded; fascinated by symmetry, graphs and proofs. Connects the others' discoveries.
